summary: UBS Group AG filed a Form 6-K containing a news release responding to Swiss government announcements on new capital adequacy rules. The release comments on the government's proposed Capital Adequacy Ordinance and Banking Act amendments—no transaction, investment, or corporate action is occurring. The document serves only as a company statement on regulatory policy and does not constitute a special situation filing. It is a routine report of foreign private issuer commentary, with no deal terms, stakeholder actions, or structural changes being executed. No risk-arb angle or event-driven trigger exists.
